name: Is it better to refinish existing kitchen cabinets or install new ones?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to refinish existing kitchen cabinets or install new ones?

acceptedAnswer.text: Refinishing or repainting preserves your existing cabinet boxes and layout, making it a budget-conscious, faster choice if your cabinet frames are sturdy and functional. In contrast, full cabinet replacement gives you the freedom to redesign storage, add deep drawers, adjust ceiling heights, or reconfigure prep zones. As a finish carpentry specialist, HH Remodeling can repair existing trim, install custom crown molding, and complete durable interior painting for cabinets, or install new, custom-framed cabinetry when an updated floor plan or better accessibility is the priority.
acceptedAnswer.description: Refinishing is faster and more cost-effective if your cabinet boxes are structurally sound, while replacement lets you reconfigure the kitchen layout and maximize usable storage.
